entries.title: Accordion
entries.description: Apply a series of wrangles to column(s) containing lists. The wrangles will be applied to each element in the list and the results will be returned back as a list.

recipe_writer.reason: Nested-list orchestration is not supported in the baseline.

entries.title: Batch
entries.description: Split the data into batches for executing a list of wrangles. Use this in situations such as where the intermediate data is too large to fit in memory.

entries.title: Classify
entries.description: Run classify wrangles on the specified columns. Requires WrangleWorks Account and Subscription.

entries.title: Clean Whitespaces
entries.description: Condense multiple spaces to a single space and convert special space characters to a standard space.

entries.title: Lists
entries.description: Compare multiple lists and return the intersection, difference, or union.

entries.title: Text
entries.description: Compare two strings and return the intersection or difference, use overlap to find the matching characters between the two strings, or use similarity to get a numeric similarity score.

entries.title: Case When
entries.description: Assign values to a column based on conditional logic.

entries.title: Score Search Results
entries.description: Scores and filters search results based on progressive partial/exact matching. Can return dictionaries or a parallel list of formatted strings.

entries.title: Concurrent
entries.description: Run multiple wrangles concurrently rather than sequentially. Wrangles must specify output columns to be used concurrently. When using concurrent, Wrangles may not complete in a predictable order and it is not recommended to update overlapping columns with different wrangles.

recipe_writer.reason: Concurrent orchestration is not supported in the baseline.

entries.title: Convert Case
entries.description: Change the letter case of text values.

entries.title: Convert Data Type
entries.description: Convert values to strings, numbers, booleans, or datetimes.

entries.title: Fraction to Decimal
entries.description: Convert fractions to decimals.

entries.title: Convert From JSON
entries.description: Parse JSON text into lists, objects, scalars, booleans, or null values.

entries.title: From YAML
entries.description: Convert a YAML representation into an object.

entries.title: To JSON
entries.description: Convert an object to a JSON representation.

entries.title: To YAML
entries.description: Convert an object to a YAML representation.

entries.title: Copy
entries.description: Make a copy of a column or a list of columns.

entries.title: Bins
entries.description: Create a column that groups data into bins.

entries.title: Column
entries.description: Create column(s) with a user defined value. Defaults to None (empty).

entries.title: Embeddings
entries.description: Create an embedding based on text input.

entries.title: GUID
entries.description: Create column(s) with a GUID.

entries.title: Hash
entries.description: Create a hash of a column.

entries.title: Index
entries.description: Create column(s) with an incremental index. e.g. 1,2,3...

entries.title: Jinja
entries.description: Output text using a jinja template.

entries.title: UUID
entries.description: Create column(s) with a UUID.

entries.title: Date Calculator
entries.description: Add or Subtract time from a date.

entries.title: Drop
entries.description: Drop (Delete) selected column(s).

entries.title: Explode
entries.description: Explode a column of lists into rows.

entries.title: Address
entries.description: Extract parts of addresses. Requires WrangleWorks Account.

entries.title: AI
entries.description: Extract structured data from each input row using an AI model. Define the desired fields with output, or reuse a saved definition with model_id.

entries.title: Attributes
entries.description: Extract numeric attributes from the input such as weights or lengths. Requires WrangleWorks Account.

entries.title: Brackets
entries.description: Extract text properties in brackets from the input.

entries.title: Codes
entries.description: Extract alphanumeric codes from the input. Requires WrangleWorks Account.

entries.title: Custom
entries.description: Extract data from the input using a DIY or bespoke extraction wrangle. Requires WrangleWorks Account and Subscription.

entries.title: Date Properties
entries.description: Extract date properties from a date (day, month, year, etc...).

entries.title: Date Range
entries.description: Extract date range frequency from two dates.

entries.title: HTML
entries.description: Extract elements from strings containing html. Requires WrangleWorks Account.

entries.title: Properties
entries.description: Extract text properties from the input. Requires WrangleWorks Account.

entries.title: Regex
entries.description: Extract matches or specific capture groups using regex.

entries.title: Filter
entries.description: Filter the dataframe based on the contents. If multiple filters are specified, all must be correct. For complex filters, use the where parameter.

entries.title: Dates
entries.description: Format a date.

entries.title: Pad
entries.description: Pad a string to a fixed length.

entries.title: Prefix
entries.description: Add a prefix to a column.

entries.title: Format Price Breaks
entries.description: Expand non-empty price-break cells into paired category and value columns.

recipe_writer.reason: This newer wrangle is outside the pinned baseline.

entries.title: Remove Duplicates
entries.description: Remove duplicates from a list. Preserves input order.

entries.title: Significant Figures
entries.description: Format a value to a specific number of significant figures.

entries.title: Suffix
entries.description: Add a suffix to a column.

entries.title: Trim
entries.description: Remove excess whitespace at the start and end of text.

entries.title: Ai
entries.description: Generate structured AI output for each recipe row.

entries.title: Huggingface
entries.description: Use a model from huggingface.

entries.title: Log
entries.description: Log the current status of the dataframe.

recipe_writer.reason: Operational logging steps are not authored in the baseline.

entries.title: Lookup
entries.description: Lookup values from a saved lookup wrangle.

entries.title: Math
entries.description: Apply a mathematical calculation.

entries.title: Maths
entries.description: Deprecated alias for `math`; evaluate an expression and write its result to an output column.

entries.title: Matrix
entries.description: Apply a matrix of wrangles to the dataframe. This will run the wrangles for each combination of the variables.

recipe_writer.reason: Matrix orchestration is not supported in the baseline.

entries.title: Coalesce
entries.description: Take the first non-empty value from a series of columns or lists.

entries.title: Concatenate
entries.description: Concatenate a list of columns or a list within a single column.

entries.title: Dictionaries
entries.description: Take dictionaries in multiple columns and merge them to a single dictionary.

entries.title: Key Value Pairs
entries.description: Create a dictionary from keys and values in paired columns e.g. COLUMN_NAME_1, COLUMN_VALUE_1, COLUMN_NAME_2, COLUMN_VALUE_2 ...

entries.title: Lists
entries.description: Take lists in multiple columns and merge them to a single list.

entries.title: To Dict
entries.description: Take multiple columns and merge them to a dictionary (aka object) using the column headers as keys.

entries.title: To List
entries.description: Take multiple columns and merge them to a list.

entries.title: Python
entries.description: Apply a simple single-line python command. For more complex python use a custom function. Note, this evaluates the python command - be especially cautious including variables from untrusted sources within the command string. The python command will be evaluated once for each row and the result returned. Reference column values by using their name. Non-alphanumeric characters within column names are replaced by underscores (_) Additionally, all columns are available as a dict named kwargs. Additional parameters set for the wrangle will also be available to the command.

entries.title: Recipe
entries.description: Run another recipe as a wrangle against the current dataframe.

recipe_writer.reason: Nested recipe composition is outside the baseline.

entries.title: Reindex
entries.description: Changes the row labels and column labels of a DataFrame.

entries.title: Remove Words
entries.description: Remove all the elements that occur in one list from another.

entries.title: Rename
entries.description: Rename a column or list of columns.

recipe_writer.reason: Structural rename steps are not supported in the baseline.

entries.title: Replace
entries.description: Quick find and replace for simple values. Can use regex if 'input' in params and isinstance(params['input'], list):in the find field.

entries.title: Round
entries.description: Round column(s) to the specified decimals.

entries.title: Find Links
entries.description: Perform web searches to find links. Returns structured search results with titles, links, snippets, and optional pricing.

entries.title: Retrieve Link Content
entries.description: Retrieves targeted content from web pages using LLM URL extraction. Can optionally output a second column containing a clean, human-readable text summary of the retrieved data.

entries.title: Columns
entries.description: Select columns from the dataframe.

entries.title: Dictionary Element
entries.description: Select one or more element of a dictionary.

entries.title: Element
entries.description: Select elements of lists or dicts using python syntax like col[0]['key'].

entries.title: Group By
entries.description: Group and aggregate the data.

entries.title: Head
entries.description: Return the first n rows.

entries.title: Highest Confidence
entries.description: Select the option with the highest confidence from multiple columns. Inputs are expected to be of the form [<<value>>, <<confidence_score>>].

entries.title: Left
entries.description: Return characters from the left of text. Strings shorter than the length defined will be unaffected.

entries.title: Length
entries.description: Calculate the lengths of data in a column. The length depends on the data type e.g. text will be the length of the text, lists will be the number of elements in the list.

entries.title: List Element
entries.description: Select a numbered element of a list (zero indexed).

entries.title: Right
entries.description: Return characters from the right of text. Strings shorter than the length defined will be unaffected.

entries.title: Sample
entries.description: Return a random sample of the rows.

entries.title: Substring
entries.description: Return characters from the middle of text.

entries.title: Tail
entries.description: Return the last n rows.

entries.title: Threshold
entries.description: Select the first option if it exceeds a given threshold, else the second option.

entries.title: Similarity
entries.description: Calculate the cosine similarity of two vectors.

entries.title: Sort
entries.description: Sort the data.

entries.title: Dictionary
entries.description: Split one or more dictionaries into columns. The dictionary keys will be returned as the new column headers. If the dictionaries contain overlapping values, the last value will be returned.

entries.title: List
entries.description: Split a list in a single column to multiple columns.

entries.title: Text
entries.description: Split a string to multiple columns or a list.

entries.title: Tokenize
entries.description: Split text into tokens. A variety of methods are available. The default method is to split on spaces.

entries.title: SQL
entries.description: Apply a SQL command to the current dataframe. Only SELECT statements are supported - the result will be the output.

entries.title: Standardize
entries.description: Deprecated compatibility key for `standardize.custom`, which standardizes data using a trained DIY or bespoke model.

entries.title: Standardize Clean
entries.description: Repair common encoding, Unicode, HTML character reference, control character, and whitespace problems locally.

entries.title: Standardize Custom
entries.description: Standardize data using a DIY or bespoke standardization wrangle. Requires WrangleWorks Account and Subscription.

entries.title: Translate
entries.description: Translate the input to a different language. Requires WrangleWorks Account and DeepL API Key (A free account for up to 500,000 characters per month is available).

entries.title: Transpose
entries.description: Transpose the DataFrame (swap columns to rows).

entries.title: Try
entries.description: Try a list of wrangles and catch any errors that occur.

recipe_writer.reason: Error-control orchestration is not supported in the baseline.
